thread:
Maria Chen: FYI invoice INV-2026-0421 ($42,300) ACH debit bounced this morning. Customer (Delphic AI) emailed asking to split remaining balance into two wires. They already paid $9,500 earlier this week.
Leo Novak: any reason given for the ACH fail? temporary bank hold or closed account?
Maria Chen: they said "bank placed temporary authorization hold" and cited payroll timing. attached their email excerpt.
Samir Patel: Sales is ok to cooperate given this is a pilot customer, but we need controls. propose: 1) signed amendment to SOW with new payment dates, 2) PO or written approval from CFO, 3) wire-only for the rest.
Jess Ortega: agree. also request a clearing clause: if any scheduled wire misses, account goes to credit hold and we stop access to Dedicated capacity. legal sign-off not needed if amendment is < $100k but must be signed by authorized signatory.
Maria Chen: Customer proposed schedule in their note: 
```
- 2026-03-23: $9,500 (received)
- 2026-04-30: $16,400 (wire)
- 2026-05-30: $16,400 (wire)
```
Customer asked to suspend dunning while they complete paperwork.
Leo Novak: I'll push for wire instructions and beneficiary details. also request remittance advice on the wire.
Samir Patel: I'm happy to loop in Delphic's CFO (cc in their email). I'll draft a short email asking for the signed amendment + PO by EOD 2026-03-27.
Collections Bot: [automated] Invoice INV-2026-0421 status updated: PAST_DUE -> PARTIAL_PAID. Dunning stage: 2. Next auto-email scheduled: 2026-03-29.
Jess Ortega: Finance decision: we will accept a two-installment wire plan provisionally. Conditions: amendment signed by customer exec, copy of PO or CFO email confirmation, both remaining payments wired. If docs are received, Collections Bot should pause outgoing dunning emails and set invoice flag "payment-plan: approved-pending-docs".
Maria Chen: drafting amendment now. adding wire beneficiary clause and a sentence about fees for returned payments. sending to @Samir and @Jess for review.
Leo Novak: added a follow-up task in our collections tracker for 2026-03-28 to confirm receipt of PO/signature and to verify the first scheduled wire on 2026-04-30.
Samir Patel: pinging Delphic CFO now. will update thread when they reply. :email:
